wallet.demoDescription: A simulated wallet for trying every workflow. No extension, no keys, nothing real is involved.
wallet.extensionMissing: {{name}} extension not detected in this browser.
wallet.connectDescription: Choose how to connect on {{chain}}. ChainBeat only ever reads your public address.
wallet.safetyNote: ChainBeat never asks for your private key or seed phrase, and never signs or broadcasts transactions.

errors.not-installed: That wallet extension isn't installed in this browser.
errors.rejected: The connection request was declined in the wallet.
errors.unsupported-chain: The wallet doesn't support this network yet.
errors.unknown: The wallet couldn't connect. Try again.

activity.title: Recent activity (simulated)
activity.empty: No simulated activity yet. Try a swap, a stake or a send.

confirm.title: Review transaction
confirm.demoNotice: Demo Mode: this is a simulation. No blockchain transfer occurs, nothing is signed or broadcast, and only the Demo wallet's balances in this browser change.
confirm.failedBody: Error simulation is on in the Demo controls. Nothing was changed.

swap.description: Exchange assets at simulated market rates. No real liquidity pool is involved.
swap.notice: Prices come from the simulator. The swap only changes the Demo wallet balances stored in this browser.
swap.doneBody: Only your Demo wallet balances changed. Nothing was broadcast.

errors.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.insufficient: Not enough {{symbol}} in the Demo wallet.

swap.confirmDescription: Check the quote. Confirming only changes the Demo wallet in this browser.

send.description: Send tokens on {{chain}}. The recipient address is validated, including its checksum.
send.notice: Nothing is signed or broadcast. Only your Demo wallet balances change.
send.doneBody: Your Demo wallet balance was updated. No transaction was broadcast.

errors.addressFormat: This is not a valid address (bad format or checksum).
errors.addressPrefix: Addresses on this network start with “{{prefix}}1”.
errors.addressLength: The address has an unexpected length.
errors.memoLong: The memo must be {{max}} characters or fewer.
errors.tooLarge: That amount is larger than the maximum this form accepts.

send.confirmDescription: Check the details. Confirming only changes the Demo wallet in this browser.

portfolio.description: Balances, staking and rewards of the Demo wallet.
portfolio.realBody: ChainBeat Demo Mode doesn't read real on-chain balances. Use the Demo wallet to explore the portfolio, swap, stake and send workflows.
portfolio.historyNote: Value of your current holdings at simulated prices over the last 30 days. It does not replay past balances.
portfolio.historyLabel: Portfolio value over the last 30 days
portfolio.noRecentTx: No transactions yet. Try a swap, a stake or a send.
